from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class ArvanaEPSPoint(BaseModel):
    """A single Earnings Per Share data point found in a financial statement."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company issuing the filing")
    fiscal_year: str | None = Field(description="The fiscal year the EPS value corresponds to (e.g., '2021')")
    eps_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of EPS reported, e.g., 'Basic', 'Diluted', 'Basic Net Loss'")
    eps_value: float | None = Field(description="The EPS amount as reported (use negative sign for losses)")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="Scale of the amount, e.g., 'dollars', 'thousands'")
    adjustment_note: str | None = Field(description="Notes on capital structure adjustments (e.g., '3-for-1 split retroactive')")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Verbatim text containing the EPS figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    eps_points: list[ArvanaEPSPoint]
